decision: PHASE 09M BIR NOTICE LOA TRIAGE INTENT SCAFFOLD PASS WITH STRICT RECOMMENDATIONS
objective: Provide a design-only, non-runtime-active scaffold classifying Philippine BIR audit-related documents/notices into safe workflow intent classes (notice type, procedural stage, routing targets) without giving unsupported legal conclusions, without activating runtime behavior, and without wiring anything to /ask. This scaffold classifies and routes; it does not decide.

BIR_ELECTRONIC_LOA.userQuery: I received an electronic Letter of Authority (eLA) from the BIR. What should I do?
BIR_ELECTRONIC_LOA.noticeText: Synthetic eLA notice text for SAMPLE TAXPAYER INC. covering CY2025 income tax and VAT. RMO No. 1-2026 single-instance audit framework applies.

BIR_REPLACEMENT_ELA.userQuery: I received a replacement eLA from the BIR. What is this?
BIR_REPLACEMENT_ELA.noticeText: Synthetic replacement eLA for DEMO LOGISTICS CORP. issued due to reassignment of the revenue officer, with broader scope covering additional tax types and a new taxable period.

BIR_CONSOLIDATED_ELA.userQuery: We received a consolidated eLA covering multiple eLAs for the same taxable period. What does this mean?
BIR_CONSOLIDATED_ELA.noticeText: Synthetic consolidated eLA for SYNTHETIC HOLDINGS INC. combining two eLAs covering the same taxpayer and taxable period CY2025.

BIR_TAX_VERIFICATION_NOTICE.userQuery: MODEL VAT TAXPAYER CORP. received a Tax Verification Notice. What is the scope?
BIR_TAX_VERIFICATION_NOTICE.noticeText: Synthetic TVN limited to a specific VAT refund claim declaration, but the examiner is now asking about broader tax issues beyond the stated transaction.

BIR_CHECKLIST_REQUIREMENTS_PRESENTATION_.userQuery: SAMPLE TAXPAYER INC. received a checklist of requirements for presentation and submission of documents. What should we do?
BIR_CHECKLIST_REQUIREMENTS_PRESENTATION_.noticeText: Synthetic checklist of requirements (Annex A) requesting books of accounts, CAS/CBA records, and general ledger for CY2025.

BIR_ADDITIONAL_DOCUMENT_REQUEST.userQuery: DEMO LOGISTICS CORP. received an additional document request beyond the original checklist. What should we do?
BIR_ADDITIONAL_DOCUMENT_REQUEST.noticeText: Synthetic additional document request for supplemental schedules not in the original checklist.

BIR_PRE_SUBPOENA_DUCES_TECUM_REMINDER.userQuery: SYNTHETIC HOLDINGS INC. received a reminder before issuance of subpoena duces tecum. What should we do?
BIR_PRE_SUBPOENA_DUCES_TECUM_REMINDER.noticeText: Synthetic reminder before issuance of subpoena duces tecum listing unsubmitted items from the original checklist.

BIR_SUBPOENA_DUCES_TECUM.userQuery: SAMPLE TAXPAYER INC. received a subpoena duces tecum. What should we do?
BIR_SUBPOENA_DUCES_TECUM.noticeText: Synthetic subpoena duces tecum requiring appearance and production of specified records.

BIR_NOD.userQuery: DEMO LOGISTICS CORP. received a Notice of Discrepancy. What should we do?
BIR_NOD.noticeText: Synthetic Notice of Discrepancy scheduling a discussion of discrepancy findings for CY2025.

BIR_PAN.userQuery: SAMPLE TAXPAYER INC. received a Preliminary Assessment Notice (PAN). What should we do?
BIR_PAN.noticeText: Synthetic PAN assessing deficiency income tax and VAT for CY2025.

BIR_CONSOLIDATED_PAN.userQuery: DEMO LOGISTICS CORP. received a consolidated PAN covering two eLAs. What should we do?
BIR_CONSOLIDATED_PAN.noticeText: Synthetic consolidated PAN combining findings from two eLAs for CY2025, properly served on the taxpayer.

BIR_FAN.userQuery: SYNTHETIC HOLDINGS INC. received a Final Assessment Notice (FAN). What should we do?
BIR_FAN.noticeText: Synthetic FAN assessing deficiency VAT for CY2025.

BIR_CONSOLIDATED_FAN.userQuery: SAMPLE TAXPAYER INC. received a consolidated FAN covering two eLAs. What should we do?
BIR_CONSOLIDATED_FAN.noticeText: Synthetic consolidated FAN combining assessments from two eLAs for CY2025, properly served on the taxpayer.

BIR_FDDA.userQuery: DEMO LOGISTICS CORP. received a Final Decision on Disputed Assessment (FDDA). What should we do?
BIR_FDDA.noticeText: Synthetic FDDA denying the protest for CY2025 deficiency income tax.

BIR_PROTEST_REQUEST_RECONSIDERATION.userQuery: SAMPLE TAXPAYER INC. wants to file a request for reconsideration against a FAN. What should we do?
BIR_PROTEST_REQUEST_RECONSIDERATION.noticeText: Synthetic protest letter requesting reconsideration of the FAN for CY2025 without submitting new evidence.

BIR_PROTEST_REQUEST_REINVESTIGATION.userQuery: SYNTHETIC HOLDINGS INC. wants to file a request for reinvestigation against a FAN with new evidence. What should we do?
BIR_PROTEST_REQUEST_REINVESTIGATION.noticeText: Synthetic protest letter requesting reinvestigation of the FAN for CY2025 with new supporting evidence.

BIR_ACTION_ON_PROTEST.userQuery: DEMO LOGISTICS CORP. received an action letter granting reconsideration of the protest. What does that mean?
BIR_ACTION_ON_PROTEST.noticeText: Synthetic action-on-protest letter granting the request for reconsideration and forwarding the case for re-evaluation.

BIR_AUDIT_TERMINATION_LETTER.userQuery: SAMPLE TAXPAYER INC. received a termination letter for the audit. What does that mean?
BIR_AUDIT_TERMINATION_LETTER.noticeText: Synthetic termination letter closing the audit for CY2025 income tax and VAT, covered by eLA number.

BIR_REQUEST_FOR_NON_CONSOLIDATION_VAT.userQuery: MODEL VAT TAXPAYER CORP. wants to file a request for non-consolidation of its VAT audit under VATAS. What should we do?
BIR_REQUEST_FOR_NON_CONSOLIDATION_VAT.noticeText: Synthetic request for non-consolidation of the VAT audit, noting VATAS involvement and pending transition rules.

BIR_WRITTEN_CONFORMITY_TO_CONSOLIDATION.userQuery: DEMO LOGISTICS CORP. is asked to sign written conformity to consolidate its FAN with another case. What should we do?
BIR_WRITTEN_CONFORMITY_TO_CONSOLIDATION.noticeText: Synthetic written conformity request seeking taxpayer conformity to consolidate the FAN with another related case.

BIR_WAIVER_OF_PRESCRIPTION.userQuery: SAMPLE TAXPAYER INC. is asked to sign a waiver of prescription. What should we do?
BIR_WAIVER_OF_PRESCRIPTION.noticeText: Synthetic waiver of prescription request extending the assessment period for CY2025.

BIR_VATAS_LTVAU_TRANSITION_NOTICE.userQuery: MODEL VAT TAXPAYER CORP. received a VATAS/LTVAU transition notice. What does this mean?
BIR_VATAS_LTVAU_TRANSITION_NOTICE.noticeText: Synthetic VATAS/LTVAU transition notice regarding pending audit reassignment.

BIR_VAT_REFUND_TRANSITION_NOTICE.userQuery: SYNTHETIC HOLDINGS INC. received a VAT refund transition notice. What does this mean?
BIR_VAT_REFUND_TRANSITION_NOTICE.noticeText: Synthetic VAT refund transition notice regarding processing office reassignment under VATAS wind-up.

The taxpayer should have this matter reviewed against applicable BIR issuances (including RMO No. 1-2026, RMO No. 6-2026, and RMC No. 14-2026) and jurisprudence by a qualified tax professional before any filing deadline.

safeWarnings: A replacement eLA may preserve audit continuity, but scope, taxpayer, taxable period, service, and underlying authority must still be checked.
Do not assume a replacement eLA is defective solely because it was issued on or after RMO No. 1-2026 took effect.
Do not assume a replacement eLA creates a brand-new audit authority when it is issued only for continuity due to reassignment or restructuring.
recommendedNextActions: Compare the replacement eLA against the original eLA for taxpayer, taxable period, and scope.
Confirm proper service of the replacement eLA.
Verify the continuity basis (reassignment, restructuring, or similar) against RMC No. 14-2026.
Escalate to professional review for legal conclusions.
